proofs.text: Run `--all --quick` over a marked pytest test asserting `1 == 2`; verify exit 1, that the output holds `the pytest runner exited`, and that the proof entry's `status` is `fail`

rule_text: A test that fails exits the run 1, names the runner that exited non-zero, and its proof entry carries `status: "fail"`

tests.body:
def test_a_failing_test_exits_one_and_records_the_failure(self, tmp_path):
        root = _pytest_project(tmp_path, body=(
            'import pytest\n\n'
            '@pytest.mark.proof("feat", "PROOF-1", "RULE-1")\n'
            'def test_no():\n'
            '    assert 1 == 2\n'))
        _spec(root, 'feat')
        code, output = _run(root, '--all', '--quick')
        assert code == 1, output
        assert 'the pytest runner exited' in output
        assert _proofs(root, 'feat')['proofs'][0]['status'] == 'fail'
tests.name: test_a_failing_test_exits_one_and_records_the_failure
